evidence: The wiki gives Dream Dust as 5% (+1.25% per 100 AP) of the target's max Health over 3 seconds, which matches the tooltip's AP ratio (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Lillia).
The wiki lists Dragon's Rage at 175/400/625 (+200% bonus AD) for both the kicked target and anyone it hits, as the tooltip says (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Lee_Sin).
The wiki gives Drunken Rage as 20/50/80/110/140 (+7% of target's max Health) (+70% AP), so the tooltip's 7% is correct (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Gragas).
The wiki lists H-28Q Apex Turret shots at 80/100/120 (+35% AP) and the charged beam at 100/140/180 (+70% AP), matching the tooltip (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Heimerdinger).
The wiki says Fate's Call holds the Oathsworn for 4 seconds, invulnerable and untargetable, which matches the tooltip's 'up to 4 seconds' (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kalista).
The wiki lists Pounce at 55/100/145/190 (+50% bonus AD) (+30% AP), so 55 at rank 1 is correct (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nidalee).
The wiki gives Lethality as 4.5/9/13.5/18/22.5/27 over 6 ranks, so the maximum is 27, not 22.5 (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Aphelios).
The wiki gives Playful/Trickster as 80/130/180/230/280 (+95% AP), raised from 90% in V12.19, which matches the tooltip (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Fizz).
The wiki lists Rocket Grab at 110/160/210/260/310 (+120% AP) and records the V25.08 raise from 105/150/195/240/285 (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Blitzcrank).
The wiki gives Fleet of Foot as 55 to 75 (based on level) bonus Move Speed for 1.5 seconds, matching the tooltip (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Sivir).

The wiki shows AD per stack scaling with level, not a flat 2.5%; its V25.23 hotfix note sets it to 1.5% to 2.8%, as the tooltip says, though the ability box lists an unsourced 2.95% top value (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Zaahen).
The wiki says the target sleeps for 2.25 seconds and has 30% Magic Resist reduction while asleep, so the tooltip's '2 seconds' understates it (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Zoe).

The wiki says Sentinel's bonus damage is capped against non-champions ('Maximum Non-Champion Damage: 100/125/150/175/200'), which covers minions as well as monsters (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Kalista).

Our script left the {{Spell_SyndraQ_Damage_0}} token unresolved; the wiki lists the real damage as 90/125/160/195/230 (+70% AP), so the game shows a value there (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Syndra).
The wiki lists Lucent Singularity's detonation at 65/115/165/215/265 (+80% AP), raised from 70% AP in V12.23, matching the tooltip (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Lux).
The wiki says Harrier deals 75 bonus physical damage to monsters (raised from 50 in V26.11), matching the tooltip (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Quinn).

The wiki lists Absolute Zero's maximum damage as 625/950/1275 (+300% AP), so the 300% ratio is correct; separately, our rendered rank-2 base of 925 differs from the wiki's 950 (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nunu_%26_Willump).
The wiki gives Takedown's bonus as 1/1.25/1.5/1.75% per 1% missing Health (up to 100/125/150/175%), so 1% at rank 1 is correct (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Nidalee).
The wiki gives Attack Speed as 9/18/27/36/45/54% over 6 ranks, so the maximum is 54%, not 45% (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Aphelios).
The wiki says The Darkin Blade deals 55%/60%/65%/70% (based on level) damage to minions, topping out at 70% as the tooltip says (https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Aatrox).
